integrity: Theorem and proof supplied with standalone executable finite verification; no third-party source text embedded. The proof, not finite tests, establishes the infinite range.
scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, Hamming diameter at most two, integer n>=3; labelled subsets, not automorphism orbits. Prior-art search cannot rule out overlooked equivalent presentations. Finite checks do not certify arbitrary dimensions.
title: Exact size enumerator and maximal faces of binary diameter-two anticodes
